alternatives.name: whatsapp-web.js
alternatives.covers: Structured Chat/Message API (getChats, fetchMessages) over Puppeteer-driven Chromium; no manual DOM-selector scraping.
alternatives.gap: Own separate QR-paired session (extra credential-at-rest); needs Node+Puppeteer(~300MB Chromium) not used elsewhere in this repo; identical ToS/ban exposure, no less risky.
alternatives.cost: Free/OSS; adds Node+Puppeteer/Chromium toolchain not currently used by any script in this repo.
alternatives.maturity: Actively maintained, VERIFIED via GitHub API today (2026-08-07): repository transferred from pedroslopez to the wwebjs org (github.com/wwebjs/whatsapp-web.js), latest tagged release v1.34.7 published 2026-04-24, most recent commit 2026-08-05 (2 days before this recheck), not archived, 99 open issues, 22359 stars. A GitHub issue-title search for open ban-related issues returned 0 hits today, versus a long closed-issue history of ban reports back to 2023; read as informational only, not as evidence the ban risk itself has gone away, since the record's own 'why' still treats web.whatsapp.com ban exposure as shared across every unofficial client.

alternatives.name: Baileys
alternatives.covers: Direct multi-device WS protocol client (no browser); reads groups/messages/media with a lighter runtime than browser automation.
alternatives.gap: The 2026 ban-wave concern is ongoing, not resolved, checked today (2026-08-07). Issue #1869 (High number of bans on WhatsApp) closed 2025-12-24 but drew comments through 2026-05-12, and the core question for this tool's use case, does read-only or personal-only use avoid bans, was asked again in the final comment and left unanswered. A newer issue, #2707 (Error 463 Reachout Timelock Causing Account Bans, opened 2026-07-14), remains open today. Still stores its own session creds as disk JSON; still Node and TS only, no Python path.
alternatives.cost: Free/OSS; Node dependency; no Chromium needed.
alternatives.maturity: Actively developed, VERIFIED via GitHub API today: WhiskeySockets/Baileys latest release v7.0.0-rc14 published 2026-07-29, most recent commit 2026-08-06 (1 day before this recheck), not archived, 344 open issues, 10637 stars. Ban enforcement remains an open, unresolved thread in the current issue tracker, consistent with the July finding of escalating rather than decreasing enforcement.

alternatives.name: Selenium
alternatives.covers: Mature WebDriver browser automation; could replace cdp_driver.py's raw JSON-RPC the same way Playwright can.
alternatives.gap: More boilerplate (explicit waits, chromedriver version pinning) than Playwright for the identical job; adopting it would add a 3rd automation convention alongside raw-CDP-here and Playwright-elsewhere.
alternatives.cost: Free/OSS; ongoing chromedriver-version maintenance Playwright already removed elsewhere in this repo.
alternatives.maturity: Extremely mature and stable, industry standard, older API model than Playwright. PyPI latest is 4.46.0, released 2026-07-11 (VERIFIED via pypi.org/pypi/selenium/json today). Not installed on this machine either (pip show selenium reports not found).

alternatives.name: WhatsApp Cloud API (official)
alternatives.covers: Fully ToS-compliant Meta API. Meta's Groups API, introduced 2025-10-06 per the official changelog, lets an Official Business Account (OBA) programmatically create, message, and manage groups it owns. VERIFIED via a live fetch of developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/groups today (2026-08-07): eligibility requires an OBA, groups are invite-link join only, max 8 participants, max 10000 groups per business number, and the page states directly that groups are not available for WhatsApp Business app phone numbers.
alternatives.gap: Confirmed today, not just asserted: the Groups API is creation and management of groups the business itself creates, not a read path into a personal account's pre-existing groups. The official Group management and Group messaging reference pages list create group, get group info, get active groups, send and receive group messages, all scoped to groups the OBA created; there is no list-my-personal-groups or read-a-group-I-did-not-create endpoint. Meta's Cloud API changelog carries no entry expanding this scope between 2026-07-25 and the most recent entry fetched today, 2026-08-04; the most recent Groups API changelog entry is 2026-05-14 and only concerns group-message read-receipt semantics. Still requires a dedicated Business-verified number and still cannot do the stated job, reading a personal account's existing groups, at all.
alternatives.cost: Free tier capped conversations/mo, then paid; needs a dedicated Business-verified number (loses normal personal use).
alternatives.maturity: Official, Meta-maintained, enterprise-grade -- for a different use case than this tool's.
